airtable(dot)com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagZk1jvydfqYXGy9/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.

JOB DESCRIPTION



We are looking for an energetic and detail-oriented individual with extensive experience managing customer order flow to join our growing team. As an Order Management Specialist, you will be responsible for processing customer orders and coordinating fulfillment logistics. The ultimate goal is to ensure that customer orders are processed efficiently, accurately and on-time.



As an Order Management Specialist, you will work as a member of our company’s Operations team. To be successful at the role, the ideal candidate must have strong customer service, communication and interpersonal skills. You will work closely with our internal team and our customers (via
 and phone) to fulfill their orders. You can expect to learn a lot about how our business functions, be professionally challenged and have plenty of opportunities for career development!



We are looking for long-term tea
mbers who will stay and grow at our company! Please apply if you have full-time availability and can commit to a long-term, mutually beneficial role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Bring in customer orders daily from various sources, including customer portals, EDI,
s and faxes

- Respond to incoming
s and phone calls with same-day service

- Confirm purchase order changes and make changes to orders in our ERP system

- Maintain accurate documentation of all actions/conversations/issues (through Front and Airtable)

- Release orders/backorders for shipping in a timely fashion

- Organize order releasing for easy picking and communicate with our Warehouse team for shipment alignment

- Create delivery slips and invoice shipped orders

- Upload/enter shipping and invoicing information to customer portals

- Create, send inventory, shipping and invoicing EDI documents

- Handle payment issues, solve order-related problems and interact with account managers as needed

- Interact with customers and provide them with information on order-related questions (such as inventory availability) and product inquiries

- Understand and ensure departmental KPIs, objectives, and guidelines are followed

- Ensure customer SLAs are followed

- Work on other duties as assigned



WHO YOU ARE

- A Bachelor's Degree

- 1-3 years experience with order management, data entry and customer service

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills; additionally, strong interpersonal skills, particularly in a customer-facing capacity

- EDI experience

- Excellent attention to detail

- Strong organizational skills; self-motivated and proactive

- MS Excel ability

- Excellent English skills

- Ability to work with our US team via
, Slack and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable and Notion

- Positive, kind and easy to work with

- A team player mentality - one team, one dream!

- Positive and kind

- A desire to learn and grow within our organization

- Willingness to learn and adopt new tools

- Reliable and detailed-oriented

- Stable, trustworthy highly dependable. Ideally someone seeking a long-term relationship where we can both grow from the relationship



HOURS

Fixed Schedule, M-F, US Central Time



ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS

HiEnd Accents creates designer bedding and home decor. Founded by a husband-wife team in 2005, we remain a family business today. Our customers love our unique designs across a wide range of styles, everyday luxury pricing and commitment to excellent service. We sell on both a wholesale as well as retail basis and are based in Irving, TX.



WHY HIEND ACCENTS?

Our small size and fast-paced culture reward people who act and think like owners. If you're someone who has a growth mentality, strives for exceptionalism, are a committed professional and a straight shooter, you’ll fit in with our culture and go far with our company.



Working at HiEnd Accents means that you can expect the following:

- Competitive Compensation - We offer a highly competitive compensation package, including 13th Month Pay

- Professional Growth - We invest in our people and make sure that they have the opportunity to continuously learn, grow and develop their careers

We’re hiring a structured, reliable, and proactive Amazon Virtual Assistant (Part-Time) to support day-to-day Amazon operations for Belfort Music (US & EU).



You’ll help keep our Seller Central accounts clean and healthy, support customer service via Zendesk, maintain listings through flat files, and improve documentation and SOPs. This role is ideal for someone who loves systems, accuracy, and continuous improvement — and who uses AI tools to work faster and smarter.



Responsibilities

Amazon Account Operations

Qualifications



To succeed in this role, you should bring a combination of experience, structure, and a growth-oriented mindset.



Must-Have Qualifications

Benefits

title: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER
description:
Role: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER

FULLY REMOTE | GLOBAL | FULL-TIME



THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring a Social Media Manager who will take full ownership of a personal brand's presence across Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. This is not a support role. You'll set the strategy, shape the content, hit publish, and be accountable for what happens next.

Short-form video is the heartbeat of this role. You know how to open strong, hold attention, and leave people wanting more. You write captions that sound like a real person not a brand brief. And you treat consistency as a baseline, not a goal.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1.  Strategy & Planning

Build and manage the content calendar week to week

Create a distinct approach for each platform IG, TikTok, and LinkedIn each need their own

Spot trends before they peak and act on them fast

Turn existing content recordings, interviews, written pieces  into fresh short-form posts



2. Content Creation & Editing

Edit short-form videos with sharp pacing and a clear opening hook

Design on-brand graphics and carousels for LinkedIn and Instagram

Write captions that match the founder's voice not a generic template

Deliver content that is ready to post, not ready to be revised



3. Community & Publishing

Schedule and publish content on time, every time

Respond to comments and DMs in a way that reflects the brand well

Handle difficult 
nts  a negative comment, a misread post with a clear head

Stay on top of the inbox, not behind it.



4. Performance & Reporting

Track what's working and what isn't then do something about it

Test different hooks, formats, and posting times

Share clear, concise performance updates without being asked

Grow reach, retention, and engagement over time



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS

These are the gates. Missing any one of them is a pass, no exceptions, no matter how strong the rest of the application.



At least 3 years running social media for a personal brand, creator, or founder not a corporate account.

A portfolio that shows real results on Instagram Reels and TikTok: growth, reach, or engagement you can point to

Solid LinkedIn experience you know how to write professional content that people actually read

Strong short-form video editing using CapCut; Canva for graphics

Writing that sounds natural you can capture someone's tone without needing a five-page brand guide

Comfortable working with AI tools to speed up content production and scheduling

Sharp eye for detail quality matters in every caption, every cut, every post

Works independently across time zones without needing daily check-ins

Native or near-native English fluency.



NICE TO HAVE — TIEBREAKERS

Adobe Premiere Pro

 Descript

 Experience preparing YouTube long-form content titles, thumbnails, and descriptions.



WHY THIS ROLE

You own the content, this is not a task-execution role

Your work goes live to a real audience from day one

Direct access to the founder, fast feedback, and no bureaucratic layers

Fully remote with the freedom to structure your work around results

Strong performers are recognized and given room to grow.





YOU ARE NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

Think in hooks first, topics second

Know the difference between content that performs and content that just fills a slot

Build your own systems so nothing falls through the cracks

Catch problems and fix them before anyone has to ask

Care about the details: the timing, the pacing, the caption, the thumbnail

Follow trends because you're genuinely plugged in not because it's on a checklist

Stay sharp under pressure and keep the quality up when the timeline is tight.





HOW TO APPLY

Send your application with the subject line: 

SMM — [Your Full Name]



Your application must include:

Your CV or LinkedIn profile

A portfolio showing short-form work — Instagram Reels and TikTok required; LinkedIn posts and YouTube Shorts are a plus

A cover letter written by you, for this role — not a template

A short Loom video walking us through your background and one piece of work you're proud of and why



Answer all 4 of the following questions:

Do not skip any. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

1. Tell us about a social media account you've managed. What did you actually do, and what changed because of it?

2. How do you write captions that sound like the person and not like a social media manager? Give us a real example.

title: Dashboard Developer
description:
About us

We are a fractional data team for fashion and apparel brands. We replace in-house data hires with a small senior team that owns each brand's analytics stack end to end: BigQuery warehouse, dbt transformations, and the BI layer on top. Our clients include several DTC and wholesale apparel companies in the US and Europe.



We are looking to add a freelancer who can take well-specified dashboard requirements and turn them into production-quality Looker Studio and Power BI reports.



What you'll do

Build dashboards in Looker Studio and Power BI against BigQuery-backed views and tables that we provide

Work from written specs (data source name, columns, visual type, filters, drill paths, target page layout) plus reference screenshots of legacy reports we are migrating

Match the look and behavior of existing client dashboards when rebuilding, or apply a clean default style when greenfield

Write the DAX measures and Looker Studio calculated fields needed for KPIs, YOY comparisons, and segment rollups

Iterate quickly on review feedback: add a column, swap a visual, fix a filter, change a sort

Flag spec gaps or data issues before building around them



What you do not do

You are not designing the data model. We hand you the BigQuery view or table, the field list, and the semantics. You build on top.

You are not the client point of contact. Reviews come through us.

Required

Strong production experience with both Looker Studio and Power BI (not just one)

Comfortable writing DAX measures: time intelligence (YOY, MTD, rolling), filter context, basic CALCULATE patterns

Comfortable connecting Power BI and Looker Studio to BigQuery as a data source, including parameterized connections and scheduled refresh

Reading and querying SQL at the level needed to sanity-check whether a number on your dashboard matches the source view

Reliable communication on Slack, fast turnaround on iteration cycles

Able to commit to at least 10 hours per week of focused dashboard work



Nice to have

Apparel, retail, ecommerce, or DTC reporting experience

Familiarity with rebuilding legacy Power BI files (.pbix) against new data sources

Experience with the Microsoft Fabric / Power BI Service workspace, gateways, and row-level security

dbt familiarity (you do not need to write dbt models, but understanding ref/source is a plus)



How we work

Specs and assets land in a shared folder per project. Each dashboard has a single owner on our side who answers questions and reviews iterations.

We expect short feedback loops: a first cut on a page within a couple of days, then revisions in hours, not days.

Invoicing monthly against tracked hours.



To apply

Send:

Two or three samples of dashboards you have built in each tool (Looker Studio and Power BI). Mock data is fine if real samples are confidential.

One paragraph on a project where you matched or rebuilt a legacy dashboard against a new data source. What broke, what you fixed.



Your hourly rate in USD or EUR and weekly availability.

title: Paralegal/Attorney – Criminal Defense
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Paralegal or Attorney to support our criminal defense practice. This role requires in-depth knowledge of criminal law, including motion preparation, legal research, and document management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing motions, drafting legal documents, and ensuring compliance with legal procedures. They will work closely with attorneys to ensure the defense strategy is executed effectively, and help prepare cases for court. This is a remote position requiring exceptional written English, organizational skills, and a strong grasp of U.S. criminal law procedures fundamentals.



Key Responsibilities:



• Draft, review, and be prepared to file various legal documents including motions, briefs, and memoranda.

• Prepare appendices for motions, including organizing exhibits, declarations, and supporting documentation.

• Prepare the table of contents for legal filings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with court rules.

• Conduct in-depth legal research on complex criminal law issues and generate a research summary for the attorney.

• Analyze discovery materials to identify critical issues and inconsistencies.

• Prepare memoranda and case summaries to aid in litigation strategy.

• Assist in the preparation of motions for hearings, trials, and appeals, including motions to suppress evidence, dismiss charges, or modify bail.

• Manage case files, ensuring all relevant documents and evidence are properly documented and stored.

• Prepare discovery responses, subpoenas, and other legal documents as directed.

• Coordinate with clients, witnesses, and experts to gather information and evidence for cases.

• Maintain communication with the court, opposing counsel, and clients regarding motions, hearings, and court dates.

• Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits, trial briefs, and witness lists.

• Ensure all legal documents comply with applicable state and federal rules and deadlines.



Qualifications:



• Must be a Graduate of a law school (JD).

• Proven experience in criminal defense law, specifically in motion practice.

• Strong knowledge of court rules, procedures, and legal writing standards.

• Experience preparing appendices, tables of contents, and organizing large case files.

• Excellent research, analytical, and writing skills.

• Must have strong knowledge of legal citation

• Ability to manage multiple cases and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

• Experience with legal research tools (e.g.,Lexis/Nexis and Westlaw) and document management software, such as Clio CRM software.



Preferred:



• Prior experience in criminal defense law or litigation.

• Knowledge of specific motions in criminal defense, including motions to suppress, dismiss, and motions for bond 

        reductions.

• Familiarity with Nevada local court rules and procedures in criminal defense.



Application Process:



Interested candidates should submit the following:

• An updated resume.

• A cover letter detailing your experience with U.S. criminal law and Clio software.

• Two writing samples (legal motions or briefs preferred) with how long it required the applicant to finalize the presented 

        document (in hours) from the time the assignment was given to the document presented.

title: VA doing Video Editing and Voice Acting
description:
We are looking for a talented and self-driven Video Editor & Voiceover Artist to help produce YouTube content in a style similar to the channel Neu — narration-driven, visually engaging videos that keep viewers hooked from start to finish. You will receive a written script and be responsible for recording your own voiceover, sourcing relevant footage and visuals online, and editing everything into a polished, high-retention video.



What you'll do

Read and understand the provided script before starting production.

Record a professional voiceover reading of the script — your own voice, no AI.

Research and source footage, images, and b-roll online that visually match and enhance the narration at each moment.

Edit the full video in DaVinci Resolve (preferred), ensuring smooth pacing, good audio quality, and strong viewer retention.

Ensure visual content is well-matched to the voiceover — every clip should feel intentional and support what's being said.

Deliver ready-to-upload videos on a consistent schedule.



Requirements

Proficient in DaVinci Resolve (other NLEs considered, but DaVinci Resolve is strongly preferred).

Native-level or near-native English — clear, neutral accent with no heavy regional inflection. A masculine voice is required for this role.

Strong ability to find and select compelling, high-quality footage that matches narration context.

Sharp eye for detail — timing, audio sync, clip selection, and overall video quality must be consistently high.

Fast learner who can adapt to feedback and evolving content guidelines.

Proactive attitude — you flag issues, suggest improvements, and don't wait to be told what to do next.

Reliable internet connection and a proper microphone/recording setup.

Available to work approximately 6 hours per day.



Nice to have

Experience editing narration-driven YouTube videos (documentary or educational style).

Familiarity with stock footage platforms (Pexels, Pixabay, Storyblocks, etc.).

Basic color grading and audio mastering skills.



How to apply

To be considered, your application must include both of the following:



1. Editing portfolio — links to YouTube videos or downloadable samples showcasing your previous work. We especially want to see narration-driven or documentary-style edits, but any strong editing work is welcome.

2. Voiceover sample — a short audio or video recording (1–2 minutes) of you reading any text of your choice in English. This is how we assess your voice, clarity, and delivery. Use whatever recording setup you have — we're listening for tone and naturalness, not studio production quality.

Applications missing either the portfolio or the voiceover sample will not be reviewed.

description:
Job Description



We are looking for an expert B2B cold
 strategist to help us generate qualified sales conversations and booked calls for our AI consulting and AI audit services.



This role is not just for basic list building or
 sending. We need someone who can own the full outbound process: ICP strategy, lead sourcing,
 infrastructure, cold
 copywriting, campaign setup, deliverability, testing, reporting, and optimization.



Our offer helps businesses identify where AI can reduce manual work, improve operations, support sales/marketing efficiency, and create measurable business value.



Important Requirement

For the initial 2-week paid test project, our goal is to book at least 10 qualified sales calls.



Please apply only if you are confident you can work within the $300–$400 initial test budget and help us reach this target.

	•	Qualified leads generated

	•	Campaign volume

	•	Industry or niche served

	•	Screenshots, case studies, reports, or other proof where possible



We understand results can depend on offer, audience, infrastructure, and market conditions, but we are looking for someone who has a proven process and can show evidence of similar results.



Responsibilities

	•	Define and refine ICPs for AI consulting and AI audit offers

 sequences

 warmup, bounce rates, and tracking

	•	Test different ICPs, offers, subject lines, and
 angles

	•	Track reply rates, positive replies, booked calls, bounce rates, and campaign quality

	•	Provide reporting with clear recommendations

	•	Optimize messaging and targeting based on campaign data



Requirements

	•	Proven experience running B2B cold
 campaigns end to end

	•	Strong understanding of cold
 deliverability, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, inbox rotation, warmup, bounce rates, and domain health

	•	Experience with Apollo, Clay, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, or similar tools

	•	Strong cold
 copywriting skills

	•	Proven ability to generate booked calls or qualified sales opportunities

	•	Experience with AI, SaaS, consulting, agencies, professional services, or B2B technology companies is strongly preferred

	•	Ability to show proof of past campaign results

	•	Strong communication and reporting skills



Initial Paid Test Project

- We would like to start with a 2-week paid test project with a budget of $300–$400.

- The goal of the test is to book at least 10 qualified sales calls for our AI consulting / AI audit offer.



The selected candidate will be expected to help with:

	•	ICP recommendation

	•	Lead sourcing strategy

	•	Campaign structure

	•	Cold
 sequence/copy

	•	Deliverability review

	•	Campaign setup and launch

	•	Tracking and reporting

	•	Optimization during the 2-week period



If the test performs well, this can become an ongoing role with a higher monthly budget based on results.



To Apply



Please answer the following:

- Are you confident you can help book at least 10 qualified calls within a 2-week test project and $300–$400 budget? Why?

- What proof can you share from previous campaigns where you generated booked calls or qualified sales opportunities?

- What cold
 tools do you use most often?

- What is your process for launching a new B2B cold
 campaign?

- How would you approach lead generation for an AI audit or AI consulting offer?

- How do you handle deliverability, domains, inbox rotation, warmup, and tracking?

- What would you need from us to give the campaign the best chance of reaching 10 booked calls?





Preferred Candidate

We are looking for someone who is strategic, data-driven, and realistic. We do not want someone who only sends high-volume cold
s. We want someone who can help us build a targeted outbound system that produces qualified conversations and booked calls.



Please do not apply with a generic proposal. Only apply if you can explain your process, show relevant proof, and are confident in your ability to meet the 2-week target within the stated budget.



Budget

title: Instagram Graphic Designer (Beauty Brands)
description:
Hi, I'm Amy Chen — founder of House of Content. We're a social media management agency for beauty businesses. We run our clients' Instagram profiles end-to-end, and our biggest unique selling point is grid design. Every feed we touch looks aesthetic, cohesive, and seriously professional.

I need ONE graphic designer to own the visual side of our client posts. Static posts, carousels, story templates, Reels covers, the works. You'll be the person making sure every grid we run looks stunning.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Design 20+ static posts and carousels per week across our client roster

Plan and design cohesive grids (every post needs to look beautiful on its own AND fit the grid)

Design story templates, highlight covers, and Reels covers

Build brand kits for new clients (colour palette, fonts, post templates)

Maintain brand consistency across every post for every client

Iterate on designs based on feedback fast



REQUIREMENTS



2+ years designing for Instagram (agency or in-house for a beauty / lifestyle brand)

Portfolio with proof. Real client grids you've designed, not mockups or personal projects

Strong eye for aesthetic, minimal, beauty-aligned design

Fluent in Canva AND Adobe (Photoshop and/or Illustrator)

Solid grasp of typography, colour, layout, white space

Native-level written English

Available 4+ hours overlap with Sydney time (GMT+10)

Reliable 50+ Mbps internet and backup power



NICE TO HAVE



Experience designing for beauty, skincare, cosmetics, or wellness brands

Figma experience

Photo editing / retouching skills

Experience with grid planning tools (Planoly, Later, Metricool)



DO NOT APPLY IF



This is a side hustle for you

You can only use Canva templates and can't design from scratch

Your portfolio is all mockups or personal projects with no real clients

You can't hold brand consistency across multiple brands at once

You don't actually care about beauty or aesthetic design



YOU SHOULD APPLY IF



You're obsessed with making feeds look beautiful

You take feedback well and iterate fast

You can hold the line on brand consistency across dozens of posts

You want a long-term, stable, full-time role

You follow beauty accounts for fun and know what good looks like



PAY

$5USD/hour . As the role progresses we can look at a potential full time position 

PROCESS



Send your portfolio link (NOT a resume, NOT a PDF). Must include at least 3 real client Instagram grids you've designed.

title: Social Media Video Editor (Beauty Brands)
description:
Hi, I'm Amy Chen— founder of House of Content. We're a social media management agency for beauty businesses. We run our clients' Instagram profiles end-to-end, and our biggest unique selling point is how aesthetic and professional every feed looks.

I need ONE social media video editor to own the moving side of our client content. Reels, carousels, story content, every video and every post that goes live. But this isn't just an editing role. You need to actually understand short-form. Hooks, retention, CTAs, pattern interrupts, why people stop scrolling and why they keep watching. If you can edit but can't tell me why a Reel hits 500K views, this isn't the role for you.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Edit 20+ Reels per week across our client roster from raw footage we supply

Write or refine hooks (first 1-3 seconds), captions, and on-screen text

Structure edits for retention. Pacing, pattern interrupts, payoff

Build clear CTAs into every post

Edit video and image carousels (multi-slide posts, strong hooks, swipe-through logic)

Edit story content (behind the scenes, product showcases, testimonials)

Add captions, music, sound effects, light motion graphics

Source and match trending audio to client content

Stay on top of what's working on Instagram week to week and feed insights back to the team

Maintain brand consistency across every edit for every client

Schedule and publish content using our scheduler

Iterate on edits based on feedback fast



REQUIREMENTS



2+ years editing short-form for Instagram

Genuine understanding of short-form strategy. Hooks, retention, CTAs, hook-to-payoff structure

Portfolio with proof. Real client Reels you've edited, ideally with visible view counts (50K+ ideal)

Fluent in CapCut Pro AND Adobe Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve)

After Effects basics for light motion graphics

Strong eye for pacing, rhythm, and beauty-aligned aesthetic

Native-level written English for hooks, captions, and on-screen text

Available 4+ hours overlap with Sydney time (GMT+10)

Reliable 50+ Mbps internet and backup power



NICE TO HAVE



Beauty, skincare, or cosmetics brand experience

Colour grading skills

Motion graphics beyond the basics

You follow creators like Alex Hormozi, Brett Malinowski, or other short-form strategists and can talk about what they teach

Scheduling tool experience (Metricool, Later, Planoly)



DO NOT APPLY IF



This is a side hustle for you

You're a technical editor with no opinion on hooks, retention, or strategy

You can't handle revisions and fast turnarounds

Your portfolio is all personal edits with no real client work

You only know basic CapCut templates and can't actually edit

You don't watch beauty content and don't know what good looks like



YOU SHOULD APPLY IF



You're obsessed with the craft AND the strategy of short-form

You can match the energy and aesthetic of a beauty brand

You study why videos go viral and apply it to your edits

You take feedback well and iterate fast

You want a long-term, stable role

You follow beauty creators for fun and study what's working



PAY

$5 USD/hour, paid monthly via Wise. Long-term role, potential to move into full time as we progress 

PROCESS



Send your portfolio link (NOT a resume, NOT a PDF). Must include at least 3 Reels you've edited for real beauty, fashion, or lifestyle clients.

Answer these 4 questions in your message:





What's the best Reel you've edited for a beauty or lifestyle brand and why did it work? (Talk about the hook, retention, and payoff, not just the edit)

Send me a Reel from any beauty brand that you think is GREAT and break down why it works

What software do you prefer and why?

If I gave you a 2-min raw clip of a skincare founder talking, describe your first 3 edit moves





Subject line MUST start with: "HOC EDITOR — [your name]"

Tell me your favourite beauty brand on Instagram at the end of your message. (This is a filter. Applications without it will be deleted.)



Top candidates will be invited to a paid trial edit ($20 USD). One Reel from raw footage we'll send you, judged on hook, retention, and finish. Top 2-3 trial winners will have a 30-min Zoom interview. Final pick gets a 2-week paid trial at full rate, then full hire.

title: Growth Marketing Assistant
description:
Please only apply through our careers page: 



TL;DR (because attention spans are real):

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Assistant to own the day-to-day execution of our paid social campaigns - primarily Meta, with potential to expand to other platforms over time. Right now, our Growth Lead is managing paid social alongside broader growth strategy - and we need someone to take the operational load off the team. This role exists to do exactly that. You'll handle ad uploads, campaign launches, daily optimisations, naming conventions, and project coordination support for the creative team. Your goal is simple: keep our campaigns running cleanly, our data organised, and our creative testing moving without delays. If you're detail-obsessed, great at following systems, and have some marketing operations experience under your belt, we want to hear from you.



Proficiency in English as a first language is essential for this role.



Time zone: Overlap with the UK team is required - at minimum 9am–12pm UK time

Location: Remote. Eastern Europe or Philippines.

WHO WE ACTUALLY NEED (and who we don’t)



This is not for someone who:

* Fully remote with async flexibility

* Unlimited vacation and sick leave days

* Office politics are destructive, small-minded, and evil.

We’re hiring a full-time remote Admin & Operations Assistant to help manage a wide range of backend and administrative tasks that keep our ecommerce business running smoothly. This role it’s about precision, diligence, and execution. You’ll work closely with our operations and finance teams to support internal trackers, manage reimbursements, check calculations, and assist with backend coordination. Your attention to detail and organizational skills will be essential in supporting smooth day-to-day operations and protecting the integrity of our systems.



Time zone: Full-time within Asia

Salary: USD
per month, depending on experience

Trial Period: All candidates will complete a paid trial assignment - more details below.



???? WHO WE ACTUALLY NEED (and who we don’t)

* This isn’t for freelancers moonlighting or wanting a side hustle.

* It’s not for someone who feels uncomfortable taking initiative, and who may need a lot of handholding.



This is however for someone who:

* Has at least 2 years of experience in any administrative or operations roles.

* Is tech-savvy, resourceful, and comfortable with online work.

* Has proficiency in data entry and database management.

* Have some experience with common eCommerce tools such as Slack, Google Drive, Asana, Shopify, Klaviyo, Zipify, etc. (Advantageous but not required)

* Is effective at verbal and written communication and following up is second nature to you.

* Is a self-starter, when given resources & training, can get things done without hand-holding.

* Has a natural sense of urgency. When things arise, you’re the first to tackle them.

* Is naturally detail-oriented and organized. Someone who has their desk and bedroom clean and neat.

* Thrives in a support role and always has a positive attitude.

* Is a learner at heart and is always working on self-development.



???? WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

* Review team reimbursement submissions, and track internal payments across platforms.

* Assist with administrative tasks related to inventory, platform uploads, internal reporting, and vendor coordination.

* Double-check numbers and simple calculations provided by teammates (you don’t need to be an accountant, just comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets).

* Maintain and update internal spreadsheets and trackers - making sure all data is current, consistent, and error-free.

* Help with ad hoc operational tasks as they arise - anything from submitting requests on platforms to ensure all records are complete and organized.



???? WHAT YOU GET

* Bonus Program - When we hit our company and individual objectives

* Fully remote with async flexibility

* Unlimited vacation and sick leave days

* Paid courses, coaching, and personal growth budget to help you level up

* We trust you to own your work and drive results



???? HOW WE HIRE

We believe in being clear and respectful of your time. Here’s exactly what to expect:



1. Application form: a few short questions and mini tasks to get a feel for your thinking.

2. HR Screening interview: This is a 30 - 45 minute interview to determine initial culture and role fit

3. Technical Interview: a 30 - 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager to dig deeper into your experience, mindset, and fit.

4. Paid test assignment: a realistic task (2–3 days to complete) that reflects the kind of work you’d actually do here.

5. Final Interview: Usually with our CEO, as a final seal of approval

6. Reference calls

7. Offer + onboarding: if it’s a match, we move quickly



No ghosting.

No five-round interview circus.

Just a fair, focused process designed to find the right fit for both sides.

title: Agency Ops Manager
description:
Who We Are

We're a growing digital ads agency that with a fully remote team.

We're looking for an Operations Manager who can own the entire operational + fulfilment side.



If you're the kind of person who sees a mess and instinctively wants to organize it, who doesn't wait to be told what needs doing, and who takes pride in keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes — this role is for you.



What This Role Actually Is

This is an ongoing, evolving operational role where you own the engine that keeps our service delivery running.

That means when a new client signs up and pays, you're the one kicking off the project. When a tea
mber is stuck, you're the one unblocking them. When a process is broken or slow, you're the one building the system to fix it. When a client needs an update, you're the one making sure it happens.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Project & Task Management

You'll manage everything inside ClickUp — creating tasks, building templates, automations, keeping statuses up to date, making sure projects are moving forward on schedule. When something stalls, you catch it before anyone else does.



Team Oversight

We have a small remote team across different time zones. You'll make sure everyone is clocking in on time, communicating in the right Slack channels, and delivering their work. When someone needs support, you provide it. When someone isn't pulling their weight, you address it.

Client Communication

You'll handle day-to-day client updates, follow-ups, and back-and-forth communication. You're the bridge between our clients and our team. Clients should feel looked after. your job is to provide an exceptional customer experience.



Systems, Automations & SOPs

As the business grows, new processes need to be built. You'll create automations, write SOPs, set up Slack channels and workflows, and continuously improve how we operate. If there's a better way to do something, you find it and build it.



General Operational Ownership

Things come up. Fires happen. New needs emerge. If it falls under "keeping the business running and delivering for clients," it's your responsibility. This role evolves as the business evolves — that's the nature of operations.



Tools You'll Use Daily



ClickUp 

Google Drive

Slack 

WhatsApp

Hubstaff

Pabbly 

Claude 

GHL





Who You Are



You are a leader. You're proactive. You don't wait to be told what to do — you see what needs doing and you handle it.

You're organized and detail-oriented. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.

You're reliable. You show up on time, every day, during the agreed window. No disappearing acts, no random schedule changes without notice.

You're a strong communicator. You can talk to clients professionally and coordinate a remote team clearly.

You're comfortable building systems. Whether it's an automation, an SOP, or a new workflow in ClickUp, you can figure it out and build it.

You're not precious about scope. Operations means owning whatever needs to happen to keep things running. If the business needs something new from you that's within the operational function, you step up — you don't negotiate every new task.

You have experience managing remote teams and working with project management tools.





Schedule Requirements

This is important, so please read carefully.

Your 4-hour shift must fall within the 4:00 PM to 10:00 P
lbourne time window. This is because the rest of the team is active during this window, and the whole point of this role is to be available when the team is working.





What We Offer



A stable, ongoing role with a team that values reliability and ownership

The freedom of remote work with clear expectations

A founder who respects your time and doesn't micromanage — but expects you to own your function

Room to grow as the business grows

description:

As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.





Objectives:

• Manage and organize the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.

• Act as a gatekeeper, screening and prioritizing communications to the CEO.

• Coordinate and facilitate communication between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.

• Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively handle tasks to ensure optimal time management.

• Coordinate special projects and initiatives as assigned by the CEO.





Competencies:

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Proficient in using Microsoft Office and Google Suites.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.





How to Apply:



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

- Stay Up-to-Date: Keep up with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in copywriting and outbound and inbound sales strategies. 



Primary Brand Focus:

You will primarily write copy for the Canadian Indigenous Investment Forum (CIIF), a year-round investment forum that connects Indigenous-led businesses and communities with institutional investors from the UK, Europe, and North America. Visit 
 to learn more. You will also support copywriting initiatives across other client brands as needed.



Qualifications: 

- Marketing and Sales Experience: Proven understanding of marketing and sales principles and a track record of crafting copy that drives action. 

- Research Skills: Ability to conduct thorough research and synthesise information to create compelling narratives. 

- Proven Copywriting Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience in copywriting or related fields. 

- Strong Writing Skills: Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with a keen eye for detail. 

- Creativity: Innovative thinker with the ability to generate unique ideas and concepts. 

- Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. 

- Time Management: Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. 

- Analytical Skills: Proficient in using analytics tools to extract and measure copy performance metrics (open rates, clickthrough rates, conversion rates, and engagement data) and search visibility. 

- Data-driven Thinking Skills: Ability to interpret, evaluate, and synthesise data findings and insights to inform strategic decisions and identify patterns that drive copy and campaign improvement. 

- Product/Service Knowledge: Ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of complex product or service features and translate technical specifications into compelling, customer-centric narratives. 

- Strategic Vision: Ability to position each copy within the broader context of the full campaign strategy, the marketing funnel, and brand identity, recognising that copy does not exist in isolation.

title: GoHighLevel Automation (Workflow) Developer - Full Time, Work From Home
description:
We are expanding and we need to hire a full-time person to build automations (workflows) in GoHighLevel.



This is a permanent position; we're seeking someone who wants to stay with our company long term, work with our existing team (Philippinos & Australians), continue to learn & upgrade their skills to achieve mastery.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



* Build workflows in GoHighLevel to automate CRM and marketing activities for our clients

* Discuss business & automation requirements with clients and with your colleagues, then translate those requirements into funnel/workflow designs for implementation

* Plan and create other GoHighLevel assets required (e.g. custom fields, tags, forms) prior to building the workflows

* Set up database structures in GoHighLevel, using associations and custom objects, when necessary to meet business requirements

* Use 
 and also webhooks to integrate GoHighLevel with external applications when required

* Customise the user interface by adding small JavaScript code to forms and funnel pages when necessary



NOTE: this role does not require design skills and does not involve building funnel pages or web pages; we have web designers to do that work. This role involves only automation and related technical work.





LEARNING AND GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES WITH AI:



In this role you'll have the opportunity to learn more about AI, incorporate it into your work and move to the cutting edge of this exciting technology. Training will be provided.



If you have an interest in learning more about AI, this role will be especially attractive. Some ways that you can use AI at work include:



* Using AI platforms such as Claude and Gemini to write JavaScript code for UI customisation

* Building chatbots and voicebots for clients using GoHighLevel's native AI tools

* Testing & deploying GoHighLevel's new Workflow AI for automated building of workflows

* Integrate GoHighLevel with MCP servers to provide clients with a convenient chat interface to the CRM

* Deploy AI-powered add-on software tools that analyse data in the CRM, identify sales opportunites and at-risk clients, then recommend followup actions





REQUIREMENTS:

KEY PERSONAL QUALITIES:

2. "Can do" attitude

3. Takes initiative and is efficient

4. Works well independently

5. High attention to detail

6. Consistently meets project deadlines



This is a full-time position, 40 hours per week. We pay the 13th month in December. We also provide time off in lieu if we need you to work outside your regular hours to meet a deadline. We will expect to be your only employment; we are not interested in people working for multiple clients or running side businesses.



We'd prefer that you work 8am - 4pm Phillippines time as this aligns with the business day here in Australia: 11am - 7pm Sydney time.





ABOUT US:



We are Clientflow, an Australian GoHighLevel agency focussed on providing SaaS software to white collar services businesses, such as mortgage brokers, real estate services businesses, surveyors, education & training companies, financial services businesses, etc.



We operate at a higher level of technical competence than most other GoHighLevel agencies. APPLYING FOR THIS ROLE:

, to walk us through your example and point out any ways that it is interesting, unique or was challenging to build.

title: GTM Systems & AI Operations Specialist
description:
GTM Systems & AI Operations Specialist

Reporting to: The Founder

Working Hours: Full-time, UK business hours (Mon-Fri, 9:00am-5:30pm GMT/BST)

Compensation: £1550 per month for 160 hours



The Role

This is a high-impact, full-time hire acting as the Founder’s right hand across systems, outbound, AI implementation, and light product work.



The business has shifted. We no longer build outbound systems alone — we build outbound, CRM, automation, and AI enablement for clients and ourselves, with Claude Code as the mission control for everything we do. 



We use Claude Code every single day. Most of our processes live inside it. We are looking for someone AI-native, technically confident, and genuinely comfortable building with AI as the operating layer, not as a side tool.



The single most important trait we are hiring for is the way this person thinks. 

The right mindset and critical thinking around AI is the foundation everything else is built on. Tool experience (Clay, Instantly, HeyReach) is teachable. 

The thinking - knowing how to direct AI, sense-check its output, and stay sharp instead of accepting whatever it gives you - is not. 



We would rather hire someone with a strong systems brain and genuine AI fluency, and teach them Clay from scratch, than hire a Clay expert who can’t think clearly with AI.



The Founder will continue to lead strategy, sales, creative direction, and content. You will take ownership of:



Building and running outbound systems (course signups, founder leads, client campaigns) using Claude Code, Clay, n8n, and connected APIs

Implementing AI workflows and signal-based pipelines that reduce cost (less Clay credit dependency, more direct API + Claude orchestration)

Light web/dev work — landing pages, platform tweaks, dashboards, internal tools — built inside Claude Code

Helping deliver client builds (outbound, CRM, automation, AI enablement)

Taking operational pressure off the Founder so he can focus on content and the inbound engine



This is not an “operations-only” or “Clay specialist” role.

You will be a systems thinker who speaks AI fluently, plays a critical role in revenue generation, and helps grow the business across multiple surfaces simultaneously.



Core Responsibilities



1. Claude Code & AI Operations (Mission Control) - ~30%

Operate inside the company’s Claude Code environment as your daily working surface

Build, refine, and run AI-driven workflows, skills, and automations inside Claude Code

Use Claude (and Claude Code specifically) to design and implement systems — not as a chat tool, but as an execution layer

Prompt-engineer at a high standard. Generic AI output is not acceptable.

Plug Claude into Clay, n8n, and external APIs to build cost-efficient signal-based pipelines

Continuously look for ways to replace expensive tooling (e.g. high Clay credit spend) with direct API + Claude orchestration



2. Outbound Systems & Campaign Management - ~25%

Build and run outbound systems to generate course signups and founder leads (our primary internal target)

Manage outbound campaigns across:

Instantly and Lemlist 
)

HeyReach (LinkedIn)

Responsibilities include:

Sequence setup and testing

A/B testing and optimisation

Domain/inbox rotation and deliverability

Monitoring and handling replies

Copy amendments (full copywriting = a plus)

The Founder will set outbound strategy; you implement it on the tools



3. Clay & Data Systems - ~15–20%

Build and manage Clay tables for prospecting, enrichment, segmentation

Implement waterfall enrichment, AI columns, and scalable list-building

Maintain clean, high-quality datasets

Clay is still important — but we are moving toward Claude Code + Clay together, and toward replacing Clay-only steps with cheaper API-based alternatives where possible



4. Light Web / Platform / Dev Work - ~15%

Spin up landing pages and lightweight websites (Claude Code-driven)

Make tweaks and improvements to the platform we’re building (Next.js + Clerk + Supabase + Stripe stack)

Build client-facing dashboards and internal tools

Edit and maintain existing websites

You do not need to be a senior engineer — you need to be confident shipping working code inside Claude Code and unafraid of touching a codebase or using AI to edit one.



5. Client Delivery Support - ~10–15%

Build and manage outbound, CRM, and automation systems for client projects

Support delivery of AI enablement work (Claude Code, automation, signal pipelines) for clients

Ensure builds are reliable, scalable, and produce measurable results

Potential to take increasing ownership of client-facing delivery over time



Must-Have Skills & Experience

Genuine AI literacy — confident, daily user of frontier AI models. Knows how to get a non-generic, production-grade result out of a model. Comfortable with Claude specifically.

Claude Code (or willingness to become expert fast) — comfortable working inside an AI-driven workflow repo, running skills, executing prompts, editing files, working with version control

Systems thinking — understands how outbound, CRM, automation, and AI connect at the framework level. Can design and implement an end-to-end system, not just operate one tool.

Technical confidence — unbothered by code, APIs, terminals, and unfamiliar tools. Can read a stack trace, follow documentation, debug independently.

Light dev capability — can ship landing pages, make site edits, and tweak existing apps with Claude Code’s help

Ability to learn at speed — this is a fast-moving, ever-changing environment. The next six weeks (MFOS platform launch) are make-or-break. You will not have time to ramp slowly.

Strong written English communication (client-ready level)

Experience with B2B outbound / lead generation systems — at least foundational

Clay experience (table building, AI columns, waterfall enrichment) — bonus, not required. We will teach it.

Instantly, Lemlist, HeyReach experience

n8n workflow building (especially self-hosted)



Nice to Have

Attio, Airtable, or similar CRMs

Supabase / PostgreSQL

Next.js / React / Tailwind — for platform work

Git / version control

Experience with API orchestration, especially using AI to coordinate between tools

Experience working in a GTM agency, modern revenue-ops, or AI-native environment



Ideal Candidate Profile

The thinking is the role. Tool experience can be taught. 

Thinks clearly with AI — knows how to direct an AI to a sharp, non-generic, production-grade result. Pushes back on weak output rather than accepting it.

Thinks like an operator AND a strategist

Thorough and militant on providing work of a high standard

AI-native — treats AI as an everyday operating layer, not a novelty. Comfortable being left alone with the tools to get a job done.

Strong systems brain — sees how the pieces connect and how to build the next piece

Moves fast, pivots fast, learns fast. Comfortable in a high-change, founder-led environment.

Honest about gaps — proactively flags what they don’t know so we can move them forward quickly, instead of getting stuck quietly

Comfortable following instructions when needed and operating independently when not

Generates ideas, not just executes them

Proactive, accountable, organised, and direct



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

Operating confidently inside Claude Code as the primary working environment

Independently building and running:

Outbound campaigns for course signups and founder leads

Clay tables and enrichment workflows

AI-driven signal pipelines (Claude Code + Clay + APIs)

Light landing pages and platform tweaks

Managing all active campaigns without daily oversight

Contributing to course pipeline, platform growth, and client delivery

Reducing Founder involvement in operations and delivery from 15–20 hours/week ?

title: Senior Publishing Designer
description:
Senior Publishing Designer

Client: Publishing Company

Department: Design

Hours: Full-time, 9:30am- 5:30pm U.K. Time 

Seniority Level: Senior or Executive

Salary: From GBP 950 monthly (TBD)



Role Overview



We are looking for a highly capable Publishing Designer to support the design and production of children’s books, accessible reading materials, licensed projects, annuals, symbolised texts, and related visual assets.

This role is best suited to a confident, creative and detail-focused designer who can take clear briefs, work quickly, produce visually strong layouts, and contribute ideas where appropriate. The client is not necessarily looking for someone who has come directly from a traditional publishing background. Instead, the priority is finding a strong layout designer with excellent Adobe skills, a creative eye, the ability to follow detailed briefs, and the confidence to speak up when something can be improved.



The formal UK role requires a Senior Designer who can lead visual development, manage publishing projects from concept to production, collaborate with editorial, production, marketing and external partners, maintain accessible publishing standards, and prepare technically accurate print-ready files. The meeting added further context that the client wants someone who can “make it look fabulous” when given assets, layouts and direction, particularly across creative children’s books, annuals and accessible formats.



About the Client



We are an award-winning children’s publisher based in the U.K. The wider group also includes a major online books retailer. We have a strong mission around inclusive reading and produces books for children across a broad range of needs, including specialist accessible books for children with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities.

We are highly inclusive, fast-moving, commercially focused and creatively ambitious. We want someone who can become part of the team remotely, communicate well, and contribute to a business that is willing to do things differently from traditional publishers.



Core Purpose of the Role

The designer will support the visual execution of high-quality children’s publishing projects, helping the internal team bring books, layouts, covers, symbols, marketing assets and print-ready files to life.



The role will involve:

Turning detailed briefs, supplied assets and page plans into polished book layouts.

Designing children’s publishing materials that are visually engaging, commercial and age-appropriate.

Supporting accessible publishing projects, including symbolised texts and SEND-focused formats.

Preparing print-ready artwork with strong technical accuracy.

Working across covers, internal layouts, annuals, licensed projects, promotional materials and digital assets.

Collaborating with editors, writers, production, marketing and design tea
mbers.

Bringing ideas to the table when appropriate, while still being able to follow direction closely.



Key Responsibilities



Design & Layout

Design book layouts for children’s publishing projects.

Create covers, internal spreads, visual assets, annual-style layouts and supporting sales/marketing materials.

Work from supplied assets, flatplans, editorial direction and page-by-page briefs.

Maintain visual consistency across titles, imprints, series and licensed brands.

Produce engaging layouts suitable for children, young readers and accessible reading audiences.

Support special design tasks such as artworking, colour correction, resizing, resending artwork and adapting existing files.



Accessible & Inclusive Publishing

Support the accessible books range.

Help create and maintain symbolised texts and accessible formats.

Design new symbols where required, following editorial and SEND-specialist guidance.

Maintain consistency within the symbol library / symbol dictionary.

Understand the importance of accessibility, clear typography and inclusive design.



Print Production & Technical Artwork

Prepare print-ready files to the required technical specifications.

Ensure files follow correct printing guidelines.

Set up finishing layers where needed, including spot UV, foil, embossing or similar finishes.

Review proofs and check that quality-control standards are met.

Ensure accuracy across typography, layout, image placement, file setup and final artwork delivery.



Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with editors, writers, production teams, marketing and other designers.

Take part in development or visualisation meetings when needed.

Communicate clearly if deadlines, quality or production requirements are at risk.

Be comfortable receiving constructive feedback and making changes quickly.

Speak up when something does not look right or when a better design solution is possible.



Creative Contribution

Bring creative ideas to the table where appropriate.

Contribute to project development rather than only completing isolated design tasks.

Be confident enough to suggest improvements while remaining collaborative and easy to work with.

Support the team’s fast-paced, commercially focused approach.



Required Skills & Experience



**Essential

Strong experience in layout design, ideally within publishing, editorial design, print design, children’s products, stationery, educational materials, magazines, books or similar.



Advanced Adobe Creative Suite skills, especially (ALL REQUIRED)

-Adobe InDesign 

-Adobe Illustrator

-Adobe Photoshop



Excellent layout, typography and visual composition skills.

Strong portfolio showing high-quality layout and design work.

Good understanding of print production and preparing final artwork.

Ability to work quickly while maintaining strong design standards.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong communication skills.

Ability to follow detailed briefs and work independently.

Confidence to ask questions, challenge constructively and raise concerns when needed.

Ability to take feedback positively and apply it quickly.

Strong time management and ability to handle multiple projects.

InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop are the key required tools.  

Layout design experience “in any capacity” would be highly relevant.



**Desirable Skills

Experience in children’s publishing or children’s product design.

Experience with accessible reading, SEND materials, symbolised texts or inclusive design.

Experience with licensed projects and working from brand/style guides.

Experience preparing books, magazines, annuals or educational content for print.

Experience using publishing or project management systems such as Stison.

Familiarity with Slack or similar internal communication tools.

Basic animation or Adobe After Effects experience would be useful but is not essential.

Experience contributing ideas in creative development meetings.

Experience mentoring junior designers or supporting other creatives.



Stison, Slack and After Effects are useful but not essential. 

After Effects is specifically positioned as a “nice to have” because the team sometimes uses animation.



Ideal Candidate Profile



The ideal candidate is not just a technical designer. They should be someone who has creative judgement, confidence and a practical mindset.

The client is looking for someone similar to a high-performing existing designer in the business: someone who can be given a brief, understand the desired outcome, produce something strong, take feedback well, and make work look polished without needing excessive hand-holding.



They should be:

Creative and visually strong.

Fast, practical and commercially aware.

Detail-oriented without becoming too slow.

Confident enough to have their own voice.

Comfortable speaking up if something is not right.

Able to balance speed and quality.

Positive, proactive and can-do.

Able to follow a process from beginning to end.

Comfortable working with a fast-moving, informal and highly inclusive team.

Open to constructive criticism.

Team-oriented and easy to communicate with.

We emphasize that we want someone with a “can-do attitude”, confidence, and their “own voice”, rather than someone passive who simply waits for instructions. We also want to make it clear that the role requires someone who can balance speed and quality, and who can confidently say when a rushed deadline may affect the final standard.



Working Style & Communication



We operate in a fast-paced environment where projects need to move quickly. The designer should be able to receive a clear brief, produce work efficiently, respond quickly to feedback and maintain high standards.

The team is open to the Remote Specialist working Philippines-based hours, provided communication works well. However, occasional overlap with the UK team will be useful, especially for calls where it is quicker to explain or show a task live.



The successful candidate should be comfortable:

Joining calls when needed.

Receiving visual feedback.

Making quick amendments.

Working from detailed briefs.

title: Cracked Internet-Native Video Editor
description:
Full-time, 40 hours/week, fully remote

Work during the day in your local time

Competitive compensation based on skill, taste, and creative instinct.



> Brief Company Overview 

Willo is an AI business builder that helps people turn ideas into real businesses without needing technical skills, a full team, or months of setup. Now we’re looking for someone to help us tell that story through video.



> Hiring Goal 

We’re not looking for someone to just execute edits from a checklist. We want someone we’d eventually trust to run with the brand creatively. Someone who can help shape the voice, pacing, energy, and internet presence of Willo across platforms.



This role is probably NOT a fit if you only want to clock in, edit assigned clips, and clock out. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about ideas, internet culture, startups, storytelling, and building a brand people obsess over.



We’re hiring a full-time video editor who doesn’t just “edit videos,” but actually understands what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching, and care.



We want someone who lives and breathes video trends. Someone who knows what’s working on social media platforms. Someone who has strong opinions, creative instincts, and the confidence to try different formats without waiting to be spoon-fed every instruction.



You don’t need to have 10 years of experience. But you do need to show that you already care deeply about video, storytelling, pacing, hooks, retention, trends, 
s, formats, and internet culture.



We care deeply about internet taste. Knowing what feels fresh, sharp, emotionally compelling, and culturally relevant. Versus what feels outdated, corporate, or overproduced. We value speed and iteration over perfection. We’d rather test 10 strong ideas quickly than spend two weeks polishing one video.



> Responsibilities 

We want to be completely transparent about everything you might handle. Don't let this list scare you off. You do not need to be a master of all of these on day one, but you should be excited to dive into them:



• Long-Form Video Editing: Own the end-to-end editing process for long-form content like interviews, podcasts, and deep-dive videos, keeping the pacing tight and engaging throughout. 

• Long-to-Short Repurposing: Take long-form videos and extract the absolute best hooks and insights to create high-impact short clips.

• Content Revival: Breathe new life into older, archived videos, spinning them up so they feel fresh, relevant, and brand new.

• Format Experimentation: Test multiple video styles, pacing, visual effects, and storytelling formats to see what resonates best with our audience.

• Platform Tailoring: Adapt video assets specifically for the unique cultures of Tech
,
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other platforms.

• Creative Ownership: Pitch your own concepts, tell us what trends we should jump on, and confidently express your opinions on our content direction.

• Asset Management: Organize raw footage, project files, and finished assets so our media library stays clean and accessible.



> The vibe we are looking for

You might be early in your video editing career, and that is completely fine with us. We do not care about years of corporate experience. We care about talent, drive, and taste.



• Trend Native: You understand GenZ internet culture, current vide/audio trends, and changing algorithms.

• Context King/Queen: You have a sharp ear for dialogue and know exactly where to cut a clip so it retains its full context and punch.

• Free Thinker: You do not wait around for instructions. You bring your own creative vision to the table and take pride in your work.

• Portfolio Ready: You have a collection of work (even personal projects or spec ads) that proves you can edit engaging content.

• Huge plus if: You already spend time on Tech
, LinkedIn, and TikTok, so you understand the specific audience we are talking to.

• Builder Mentality: You genuinely want to help build something big. You think beyond individual edits and care about audience growth, brand perception, 
ntum, and impact.

• Internet Taste: We care deeply about internet taste. Knowing what feels fresh, sharp, emotionally compelling, and culturally relevant. Versus what feels outdated, corporate, or overproduced.



Honestly, we’re looking for the cracked internet-native editor who’s already obsessing over hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, and why certain content explodes online.



> How to Apply

Submit your details through this Google Form: 

Don't just send a generic resume. Send us your portfolio, show us what you've built.

title: Senior Brand Marketing Strategist — Multi-Brand Pet Lifestyle + Online Course ($1,200–$1,500/mo)
description:
Chickitty Brands operates six distinct editorial lifestyle brands — Chic Kitty, Shaggy Chic, Hugo the Minskin, Selina, Cats of the World, and Paws to Profit, an online course launching in 2026. Each brand has a locked visual identity, distinct voice, and separate audience. Together, they share one founder, one team, and one goal: to grow strategically and generate revenue.

We are not looking for someone to manage a content calendar or schedule posts. We have a team for execution. We need a senior marketing strategist who can see the entire ecosystem across six brands, write copy that converts, design
 and DM flows that capture and nurture leads, map every opportunity months in advance, and deliver a coordinated growth plan to the founder for the team to execute.

Brand direction, visual identity, and final approval belong to the founder. Marketing strategy, copy, campaign architecture, and growth decisions are yours.

What you own

This is a full-scope senior marketing role. You own:

Marketing strategy across all six brands — 60 to 90 days in advance, submitted to the founder for approval before execution begins.

All marketing copy —
 sequences, ManyChat DM flows, lead magnet content, launch copy, caption frameworks, CTA language, and subject lines. You write inside our brand voice and visual system. You know what triggers a click, what opens an
, and what converts at each stage of the funnel.

 architecture — seven separate lists across six brands. You design the capture strategy, welcome sequence, nurture flow, and broadcast calendar for each.

DM automation strategy — ManyChat flows across Instagram, TikTok, and
. You design the triggers, write the responses, and map which flows serve which brand goal.

Integrated content calendars — connecting Instagram, TikTok,
 Groups, Pinterest,
, blog, and DM into a single synchronized system where each surface supports the others.

Course launch ecosystem and ongoing evergreen funnel — awareness content arc, list-building strategy, pre-launch sequence, launch week, post-launch evergreen, and future course runway.

Cross-brand promotion strategy — identifying where audiences overlap and how to move people from one brand into another without breaking brand integrity.

Sponsorship and partnership pipeline — identifying brand partnership opportunities per brand and briefing the OBM to execute outreach.

Performance measurement — monthly data summary with specific recommendations. You update the plan when the data tells you to.

What you do not own

Visual design and asset creation. Brand palettes, typography, and template design are handled by a dedicated designer and assembled by the production team.

Team management. The OBM handles daily coordination. You brief the OBM. The OBM executes with the team.

Brand identity decisions. The visual system and brand voice are locked. You work inside them, not around them.

Week-to-week reactive planning. If your planning horizon is shorter than 60 days, this role is not a fit.

Each brand is treated as its own entity

This is not a single-brand role. Each of our six brands has a distinct identity, audience, platform presence, and growth stage. What works for Chic Kitty does not automatically apply to Cats of the World. We expect you to treat each brand individually — its own strategy, its own copy voice, its own opportunity map — while understanding how they connect at the portfolio level. Generic multi-brand advice is not what we are paying for.

What we need from you

Multi-brand marketing experience at a strategic level — agency background or in-house at a company with multiple distinct brand identities. You can name the brands, describe your specific strategic contribution, and show the outcomes.

Formal marketing education or equivalent demonstrated expertise — you understand consumer psychology, funnel architecture,
 marketing principles, and platform algorithm dynamics at a level that informs real decisions.

Online course or digital product experience. You have been part of a launch or ongoing funnel that generated measurable results.

 marketing mastery — you have designed sequences that converted. You know open rates, click rates, and what moves them.

Deep current knowledge of Instagram, TikTok,
 Groups, Pinterest, and
 — not surface-level familiarity. You know the 2026 algorithm priorities for each platform.

DM automation experience — ManyChat or equivalent. You have designed and written flows that converted followers into subscribers.

Copywriting that converts — you write subject lines that get opened, CTAs that get clicked, and
 sequences that sell without feeling like a pitch.

Results you can point to. Numbers. Outcomes. Accounts grown. Funnels that hit targets. Lists built from zero.

Hard disqualifiers

Your primary growth recommendation is running paid advertising. Paid amplifies what is already working. It is not a substitute for an organic strategy.

You plan one week at a time.

You have not worked across multiple simultaneous brand identities with distinct voices and audiences.

You cannot point to measurable results from a past marketing or brand growth role.

The team you work with

OBM — operations, scheduling, team management, weekly reporting to the founder

Brand Content Producer — Canva asset assembly, Pinterest production, content preparation

Video Editor — short-form Reels across four Instagram accounts and Hugo TikTok

FB Mechanics —
 Groups, Pages, and cross-posting

Founder — brand direction, final strategy approval, daily TikTok posting

Founder approval cadence

Quarterly: 60–90-day strategy plan per brand. Submitted before execution begins. The founder approves or redirects.

Monthly: one-page performance summary with data and specific recommended adjustments.

Weekly: content calendar and copy delivered to OBM for execution. No founder involvement in weekly operations.

Role details

Rate: $1,200–$1,500/month based on demonstrated experience and results

Hours: 20 hours/week, flexible schedule, Philippines timezone

Type: Independent contractor, remote

Payment: Biweekly via Remitly or PayPal

Reports to: Founder for strategy approvals · OBM for daily coordination

Paid strategy test — required before hire

Top applicants receive a paid strategy test before final selection. $75 flat fee, paid within 24 hours of delivery, regardless of outcome.

You will receive a one-page brief for one of our brands, including current platform presence, audience size, and one specific business goal.

You will deliver a 30-day marketing strategy document — maximum three pages — covering platform approach, copy and content direction,
 or DM capture mechanism, and how you would measure success. No generic frameworks. Specific to the provided brand and goal.

We score for: specificity, current platform knowledge, ecosystem thinking, copy quality, and restraint. A focused plan with a clear rationale beats a list of forty tactics.

How to apply

Your application must answer all four of the following. Missing any one means we do not review it.

A multi-brand campaign or role you led — name the brands, your specific contribution, and the measurable outcome.

An online course, digital product, or ongoing marketing funnel you contributed to — your role, the strategy you designed, and the result.

Your answer to this question: We have six brands — a cat editorial brand at 12K Instagram followers with a 
 Group, a dog lifestyle brand at 
 with a 
 Group, a character cat on TikTok just launching, a global street cat photography brand, a luxury editorial cat brand launching later this year, and an online course called Paws to Profit. What are the three highest-leverage marketing moves across this portfolio in the next 60 days, and why those three specifically?

Your rate and availability.

Applications that lead with enthusiasm over evidence will not be reviewed.
