About Priority Haulage

Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary

Priority Haulage is seeking a capable, high-capacity, and dependable Transport Operations Officer to support day-to-day operations within a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.



The role reports primarily to the Operations Manager and works closely with the Financial Controller on systems, process improvement, and operational coordination initiatives.



This position is central to maintaining operational continuity across fleet dispatch, driver management, compliance coordination, and transport administration within a structured, performance-driven business focused on operational efficiency, accountability, and scalable systems.



Role Overview

This role is suited to an operations professional who can consistently deliver reliable outcomes with minimal supervision in a deadline-driven environment. Performance will be assessed based on operational consistency, responsiveness, task completion, communication quality, and ability to maintain established workflows and standards.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent coverage aligned with New Zealand business operations, including early morning dispatch coordination and operational responsiveness throughout the day.



Core Operational Coverage (PHT)

5:00 AM – 1:00 PM: Primary operational window covering fleet dispatch, job loading, driver coordination, and daily operational tasks.



2:00 PM – 5:00 PM: Flexible operational coverage period supporting job closing activities, operational follow-up, and preparation/loading for the following operational cycle as required.



The role is workflow and task-driven, with hours and workload fluctuating depending on job volume, fleet activity, and operational requirements. Compensation is based on actual hours worked.



Final working arrangements and compensation structure will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate based on operational requirements, workflow demands, and demonstrated capability within the role. The position is expected to require approximately 30 hours per week, with baseline workload increasing as operational responsibilities expand.



Job Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

• Job Processing

• Job Quality Control



Fleet Management

• EROAD Management

• Fuel Card Applications

• Logbook Compliance

• Leave Management

• Assist with operational coordination and process improvement.

• Support internal communication, task coordination, and workflow follow-up.

• Assist leadership with operational reporting and action tracking where required.



Progressive Responsibilities

The successful candidate will progressively support and coordinate additional operational safety and compliance functions as part of the wider operations role, including:



• Compliance & Risk Support

• Insurance Claims Coordination

• Health & Safety Administration



Required Experience & Capability

Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating within a structured, deadline-driven transport or logistics environment:

• Minimum 6+ years’ hands-on experience managing high-volume transport dispatch, fleet coordination, and operational workflows.

• Proven experience within transport, logistics, dispatch, or fleet operations environments.

• Strong organisational and commercial judgement, with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.

• Demonstrated experience using Transport Management Systems (TMS), fleet management platforms, dispatch systems, or operational workflow software.

• Ability to operate independently within a remote work environment

• Effective problem-solving capability and operational judgement.

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel capability, including, filtering, sorting, and pivot tables

• A high level of technical proficiency across the Microsoft platform and modern operational business systems, with working familiarity in tools such as:

o Notion

o ChatGPT



Preferred Experience 

• Exposure to New Zealand or Australian transport and logistics environments.

• Exposure to health & safety, driver compliance, and quality control processes.

• Demonstrated ability to improve operational workflows through process optimisation, system improvement, or automation initiatives.

• Exposure to coordinating, supporting, or overseeing operational staff within a structured operations environment.



Personal Attributes

• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to contribute effectively.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, dependable, and accountable, with strong follow-through and responsiveness.

• Able to remain calm and organised within a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong ownership mindset with consistent follow-through and responsiveness.



Required Equipment and Setup

o Processor: Intel Core i5 or better.

o RAM: Minimum 8GB (16GB preferred).

o Operating System: Windows 10/11, compatible with required business software.

You will also be responsible for grant writing using pre-canned templates for future funding opportunities, and for nurturing new relationships with donors. description:

How We Hire

We start with a 30-day paid trial at 20 hours per week, paid at AUD $1,000. During that time you'll work on real client tasks across the full scope of the role. At the end of the 30 days we have a review call. If it's a strong fit on both sides, you move straight into the full-time role at AUD $2,000/month.

You get paid for your time from day one. We just run a trial for all new contractors before giving them a larger role

- Editing short-form video ad creatives and Reels for
 and Instagram (home improvement clients)

Long-term stable role with a growing agency

A team that genuinely values the people in it

This role is to alleviate tasks from the current office manager so that she can focus on client needs, however your role could expand into this area (liaising with clients) too if you show potential.  



Hi there!  We are a small family-owned Australian based building company that has our staff and clients’ best interests at heart. We like to make sure everyone feels valued and well looked after. We undertake a lot of varied renovations such as home extensions, bathrooms and kitchens, and also have a keen interest in building new energy efficient homes.

Your purpose will be to work collaboratively with the builder and office manager to prepare building quotes for customers and to manage project schedules. The key tasks will include:

o Prepare material take offs

o Send out quote requests to suppliers and trades

o Review trade quotes and request revisions if all details are not as requested

o Enter the quote details into our Wunderbuild estimate/quote software

• Using the job scheduling section of Wunderbuild to manage jobs as follows:

o to allocate timelines and manage the schedule of the job/s as they progress. It will be imperative to communicate with the builder about job progress and adjust the schedule and keep the trades updated as timelines change.

o Liaise with local trades to confirm and adjust their onsite dates as jobs progress

o Order building materials and internal fixtures and fittings and ensure they are delivered to site on time



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

• Australian building company experience (minimum 12 months)

• Experience in job estimating and job management

• Can successfully manage a schedule of work often with multiple concurrent projects and constantly changing timelines

• Able to read and understand building plans

• Able to communicate with suppliers professionally 

• Ability to compare quotes logically and ask for revisions if required

• Strong English written and verbal communication skills

• Highly organised, with strong attention to detail 

• The confidence and resilience required to work independently

• Solution focused with a systematic work approach

• Confidence to collaborate with the team, complete tasks and meet deadlines 

• A solid work ethic, takes accountability, is reliable and punctual



REQUIRED SKILLS & TOOLS:

• Degree/Qualification in any of the following: Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Architecture, Construction Management, Drafting/CAD Background

• A working knowledge of Wunderbuild or Buildxact estimating and job management software

• Experience working with Tekmatix (GoHighLevel) – CRM Software

• Knowledgeable on use of core Google applications – Gmail & Drive

• Knowledgeable on use of core Microsoft applications - Excel and Word

• Able to use Zoom / Loom

• Ability to create/provide basic building floor plans for clients, such as a bathroom floor plan (not essential but would be an advantage)



OUR DESIRED APPLICANT QUALITIES MAY INCLUDE:

• Honest and open – we want you to talk to us about any challenges you face so we can help you learn and be confident within your role

• Looking for long term employment with a supportive team



If you possess the above requirements, we would love to hear from you.

QA Tester / Software & XR Testing - Full-Time | Remote | AUD $750-$1000 



Location: Philippines 

Working Hours: Mon-Fri, Western Australian business hours (UTC+8) 

Reporting to: Head of Web & XR Development

Works with: Head of Web & XR Development, Developers, 3D Artists, Technical Artists, Business Analysts, Project Managers



Role Overview



3D Walkabout is looking for a QA Tester to help test web applications, VR experiences, AR/MR projects, and interactive 3D content before they are reviewed by clients or released.



This role is suited to someone who is detail-oriented, patient, and good at finding issues before users do. You will be responsible for testing features, logging bugs clearly, running regression checks, and helping the team improve the quality of our builds.



You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable using software tools, following test cases, recording issues, and explaining bugs in a way that developers can reproduce and fix.



What You’ll Be Doing



- Test web applications, VR applications, AR/MR experiences, and interactive 3D projects

- Run manual test cases across new and existing features

- Perform regression testing before client reviews and releases

- Log bugs clearly with steps to reproduce, expected result, actual result, screenshots, and videos where needed

- Test across desktop, mobile, browser, and VR headset environments where required

- Check that features match requirements and acceptance criteria

- Help create and maintain test cases and QA checklists

- Verify bug fixes and confirm when issues are resolved

- Identify usability issues, broken flows, visual problems, and performance concerns

- Work closely with developers, BAs, and project leads to improve quality before delivery



Tools & Technologies



Essential



- Experience testing software, websites, apps, games, or interactive projects

- Strong attention to detail

- Clear written communication

- Ability to write good bug reports

- Comfortable using project management tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Trello, or similar

- Ability to follow test cases and check acceptance criteria

- Comfortable recording screenshots and screen captures

- Reliable and organised when working remotely



Preferred



- Experience testing web applications

- Experience testing mobile apps or responsive websites

- Experience testing VR, AR, games, Unity projects, or 3D applications

- Experience with Meta Quest 2 or Quest 3

- Experience with browser testing across Chrome, Edge, Safari, and Firefox

- Understanding of regression testing, smoke testing, UAT, and release testing

- Basic understanding of Agile workflows and sprint delivery



About You



- You notice small issues others miss

- You can explain bugs clearly without overcomplicating them

- You are patient and willing to test the same flow more than once

- You understand that QA is not just about finding bugs, but helping the team deliver better work

- You are comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear

- You can work independently and provide clear updates to the team

- You care about the user experience and the quality of the final product



Bonus Experience



- QA experience with Unity, Unreal, VR, AR, or game projects

- Experience testing training simulations or enterprise applications

- Experience using VR headsets, especially Meta Quest

- Experience writing test plans or QA documentation

- Experience testing performance, loading, interactions, UI, and edge cases

- Familiarity with developer tools, console logs, or basic technical troubleshooting



What You’ll Get



- A hands-on QA role across web, VR, AR, and interactive projects

- Exposure to real client projects that ship

- Direct collaboration with developers, project leads, and artists

- Opportunity to grow with an established XR studio



About Us



3D Walkabout is an Australian 3D visualisation and XR studio creating immersive content for clients across property, infrastructure, education, and industry. We blend creativity, technology, and storytelling to bring digital environments and products to life through 3D, VR, AR, and interactive experiences.



How to Apply



Send us:



- Your CV or LinkedIn profile

- Examples of testing work, bug reports, QA checklists, or projects you have tested

- A short note about your experience testing software, websites, apps, games, VR, or interactive content

title: SEO Assistant (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
About DCB Digital

We're a Brisbane, Australia-based SEO agency working with trades, professional services, and financial services businesses across Australia. Our clients are real operators with real revenue, not affiliate sites or thin content plays. We deliver measurable outcomes, work from documented systems, and don't tolerate drama or chaos.

Our three values are simple:



Own the outcome

Follow the system

Stay sharp



If those land for you, keep reading. If they don't, this isn't the role.



The role

We're hiring an SEO Assistant to support delivery across our active client accounts. You'll work directly with our Senior SEO Strategist and the two founders, contributing real, accountable work from day one.

Full-time, fully remote, AEST overlap hours required (Brisbane time, GMT+10).

You will own:



Executing on-page optimisation tasks across client accounts (meta titles, H-tags, internal linking, image alt text)

Uploading and formatting content in WordPress to DCB's quality standards

Running monthly citation and directory submissions

Supporting Google Business Profile management across client accounts

Compiling ranking data and preparing reporting inputs each month

Completing audits and checklists as directed by the Senior Strategist



Who we're looking for



Must-haves:



2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, agency or in-house, with a real portfolio of work you can speak to

Solid understanding of on-page SEO fundamentals. You know why H1s matter, what a canonical tag does, and whether a page is actually structured to answer the query it's targeting

You understand anchor text strategy, not just what it is. You know the difference between branded, exact match, and partial match anchors and why getting it wrong can hurt a campaign

Technical SEO is not a mystery to you. Broken internal links, redirect chains, crawl errors, page speed issues, you can identify them, prioritise them, and explain why they matter

Brand voice matters to you. You understand that content written in the wrong tone can damage a client's credibility even if it ranks, and you treat every piece of copy as a reflection of the client's business

You use AI tools in your workflow every day, not to replace your thinking but to move faster and produce better outputs. You know how to set up and structure AI projects properly, build out prompts and workflows, and get consistent, usable output at scale. You know when AI output needs editing and you have the judgement to fix it

WordPress experience. You're comfortable working inside the CMS without breaking things

Comfortable with Google Search Console and GA4 at a basic level

Proven ability to follow a brief and hit a deadline without being chased. You've never missed a submission without flagging it first

Strong attention to detail. You follow a brief, you work a checklist, you don't cut corners

Reliable, self-directed, and honest about what you don't know yet

You're not looking for a job to coast in. You want to be genuinely good at this, and you care about working with people who hold the same standard. You follow the industry, you test things, you read, and you're always looking for ways to get better results for clients

You have ideas and you share them. When you see something that could work better, you say so. You're not waiting to be asked

Native or near-native English, written. Australian/UK English preferred



Nice-to-haves:



Experience with Ahrefs or Semrush

Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project management tools

Local SEO or GBP experience



Don't apply if:



You have less than 2 years of real, hands-on SEO experience

You're still learning what SEO is and hoping to figure it out on the job

You can't commit to consistent AEST overlap hours

You need detailed step-by-step instructions for every task

You're looking for a role where you can coast



How you think

The task list tells you what to do. It doesn't tell you why it matters or what to do when something isn't working.

We want someone who reads a client's ranking report and asks why a page dropped, not someone who waits to be told. Someone who notices an opportunity in the data and brings it up. Someone who cares whether the client is actually getting results, not just whether their tasks are ticked off.

We use AI across everything we do. We've built our own internal SEO platform around it. We're not looking for someone who dabbles. We want someone who has actually set up AI projects, built out prompts and workflows, and knows how to get consistent, usable output at scale. Someone who looks at a new client account and thinks about how to set AI up to serve that client well, not just whether to use it at all. Content that sounds generated and untouched doesn't leave our agency. Neither does AI output that wasn't configured properly in the first place.

We're not building an average agency and we're not hiring average people. The standard here is high and it stays high. If you want to work somewhere that pushes you, gives you real problems to solve, and actually invests in making you better at your craft, this is worth your time. If you're happy doing the minimum and moving on, it's not.

If you've ever gone beyond your brief because you saw something that needed fixing, we want to hear about it.

What you'll be part of

We're a growing agency and we're honest about that. We're not a 50-person operation with every process locked down. We're building something, and we want people who are excited by that, not put off by it.

That means there's real room to shape how things are done here. If you come in with ideas, we'll listen. If you spot a smarter way to run a process, bring it. If you see an opportunity we haven't acted on yet, tell us. The people who grow fastest with us are the ones who treat this like their business too, not just a job they showed up for.

We're selective about who we hire because the right person at this stage actually changes the trajectory of the agency. We're not filling a seat. We're bringing someone into the team who we want to still be here in three years, growing with us as we grow.

Compensation



AUD $900 - $1,200 per month, depending on experience

Performance bonuses tied to client retention and ranking outcomes

All software subscriptions provided

Real mentorship from senior practitioners

Clear growth path as we scale. We promote from within. The Senior Strategist role exists. If you're serious about growing, the path is real

As we grow, you grow. We review performance and compensation as the agency scales. The people who help build this will benefit from what they helped build



How to apply

Send the following to 
 with the subject line "SEO Assistant - [Your Name]":



Your CV

A
word response to: "Walk me through how you would optimise an existing page for a target keyword. What would you check and what would you change?"

A
word response to: "Tell me about a time you caught an error or quality issue before it became a problem. What did you do?"

A link to one piece of SEO work you're genuinely proud of. Could be a ranking result, a piece of content, an audit, anything. Tell us what your role was and why it mattered

A
word response to: "Tell us about a time you went beyond your task list because you spotted something that would make a real difference for a client or employer. What did you see, what did you do, and what happened?"

Your earliest possible start date



We will not respond to CV-only applications. Skip the questions and you're not shortlisted.

Selection process



Application review (within 7 days)

Loom video (3 mins) for shortlisted applicants only

Video interview with founders (30 minutes)

Short paid trial task (2-3 hours of real work)

Offer



Total timeline: 2 weeks from application to offer.



Why work with us



Two founders who take the work seriously and invest in their team. Documented systems and real SOPs. You won't be guessing what's expected. AI-leveraged workflows and a multi-agent SEO platform you'll use every day. A role where you can develop into a senior practitioner if you put the work in.



We're building a team of people who want to be the best at what they do. Not a team of task completers. If you're the kind of person who finds a way to get better every week and wants to be surrounded by people who do the same, this is the right place.

title: Operations Manager VA (with US CPG Experience)
description:
Overview 



We are a health and wellness brand selling across the US market through Amazon, key distributors (UNFI, KeHE), major retailers (Walmart, and others), and direct-to-consumer e-commerce channels. We move fast, care deeply about our customers, and are building the operational foundation to scale. 

This is a high-ownership, high-impact operations role. You will be the person who keeps the business moving — making sure stock is in the right place, orders go out on time, and the supply chain runs without surprises. The best person for this role defaults to automation over manual work and builds systems so the operation scales without scaling the headcount. 



Timezone: AEST 

Hours: Part time (20 hours per week)



Key Responsibilities

1.	Daily Operations & Stock Management

•	Own daily inventory monitoring across Amazon FBA, UNFI, KeHE, Walmart, DTC, and additional retail accounts. 

•	Track stock levels, reorder points, and expiry windows for products with shelf-life constraints. 

•	Flag low stock, overstocks, and inbound delays before they become problems. 

•	Produce regular inventory and operations reports for the founding team. 

2.	Order Execution & Timely Delivery

•	Own purchase order flow end-to-end across retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels with full accountability for on-time delivery metrics. 

•	Manage all US retail and distributor documentation, including BOLs, routing guides, packing lists, commercial invoices, and compliance labels. 

•	Maintain a deep understanding of specific PO requirements, order windows, and routing rules for distributors like UNFI and KeHE. 

•	Proactively resolve fulfillment issues before they result in chargebacks, customer complaints, or lost shelf placement. 

3.	Supply Chain Coordination

•	Manage the full supply chain from production to final delivery by coordinating with co-packers, freight forwarders, 3PLs, and distributors. 

•	Oversee inbound shipments from China or other origins, ensuring customs clearance and documentation is accurate and timely. 

•	Coordinate production runs and purchase orders with suppliers using data-driven reorder calculations. 

•	Manage 3PL partner relationships and hold them accountable to SLAs for dispatch, accuracy, and claims resolution. 

4.	Systems, Automation & Workflow Building

•	Identify manual, repetitive processes and replace them with automated workflows, from listing audits to inventory reconciliation. 

•	Use AI tools and automation platforms to build systems that improve speed, accuracy, and visibility. 

•	Maintain and improve SOPs, documentation, and reporting cadences to build a scalable operational infrastructure. 

5.	Amazon & E-Commerce Operations

•	Manage Amazon Seller Central operations: account health, FBA inventory, inbound shipments, listing suppression alerts, and PPC coordination. 

•	Maintain accurate product data, pricing, and availability across all e-commerce platforms. 

•	Support new product launches and new account onboarding from an operational standpoint. 

Required Skills & Experience

•	Experience: 3–5+ years in operations, supply chain, or e-commerce, ideally within a CPG, food, or health and wellness brand. 

•	US Market Expertise: Direct experience with Amazon Seller Central, UNFI, KeHE, Walmart, or similar retail and distribution channels. 

•	Documentation: Deep understanding of US retail and distributor documentation requirements, including BOLs, routing guides, deductions, and compliance. 

•	International Logistics: Experience with international supply chains, particularly shipping from China to the US. 

•	Automation & AI: A strong bias toward automation and comfort using AI tools to streamline operations and reporting. 

•	Soft Skills: High attention to detail, strong analytical skills, fluency in spreadsheets, and the ability to move quickly and independently. 



Who This Is Not For

•	Someone who waits to be told what to do. 

•	Someone who relies on manual processes and is resistant to automation. 

•	Someone without hands-on experience in the US retail or distributor ecosystem. 

•	Someone who treats reactive fire-fighting as the whole job, without investing in building better systems.

title: Graphic Designer - AI Image Specialist
description:

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, and people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of graphic design and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our NEXT AI IMAGE SPECIALIST.



Role Purpose

This role is responsible for designing creative and compelling visuals for new and existing products, including illustrations, packaging, and listing images. You will also create diverse marketing materials such as social media graphics and website elements, as needed.



What Success Looks Like

Success in the Graphic Designer role means consistently delivering high-quality, on-brand visuals on time that enhance product listings and marketing campaigns. Designs require minimal revisions, follow brand standards, and effective product storytelling and conversion. Graphic designers use AI throughout the process of creating – and are continually updating their knowledge with software, techniques and output.



A successful designer continuously improves their skills, shares new techniques with the team, and collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams to strengthen the brand’s visual presence.



Primary Objectives

1. Deliver high-quality, on-brand designs for listings and marketing materials.

2. High usage of AI throughout design process.

3. Collaborate with product and marketing teams to align designs with objectives.

4. Optimize product images to meet e-commerce guidelines and boost performance.



Regular Work Activities

1. Develop effective product visuals, including listing graphics, packaging & instructions aligned with brand identity and target audience.

2. Collaborate with the product development and marketing team to ensure designs are aligned with product specifications and marketing objectives.

3. Create high-performing e-commerce listing images that meet platform guidelines and brand standards.

4. Edit and enhance product photography to support marketing and marketplace needs.

5. Perform color correction, background removal, image resizing, and other necessary edits to create polished and professional images.



Key Skills

Expertise in graphic design, illustration, and digital content creation

Strong understanding of brand identity and e-commerce platform requirements

Always updating AI knowledge to best use new software, and processes

Proficient in design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, etc.)

Excellent photo editing skills (color correction, background removal, resizing)

Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

Knowledge of current design trends and techniques

Self-starter who raises issues and proposes solutions before asked – a critical thinker who finds mistakes and corrects them



People Contacts and Interactions

Marketing Team – Collaborate on design concepts, campaign strategies, and promotional materials.

Amazon Operations Team – Ensure product listings and images meet Amazon’s platform guidelines and optimize performance.

Creative Asset Manager – Submit designs for review and finalize images for approval and publishing.



Role Requirements

3+ years of experience in graphic design or visual content creation

Proven experience designing for e-commerce platforms (Amazon, Shopify, etc.)

Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in product visuals and marketing collateral

Excellent communication and teamwork skills

Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment

A degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field (preferred)

title: Customer Support Rep
description:
We are a fast growing DTC women's wellness brand. Our customers aren't just buying a supplement. A lot of them are going through something really personal. Postpartum hair loss, hormonal changes, confidence struggles. How we show up in support genuinely matters to them. A warm, knowledgeable reply can actually change someone's day, and that's the kind of CX team we're building.



What a typical day looks like

- Resolving customer tickets

- Handling order tracking questions and coordinating with our 3PL when needed

- Processing refunds and returns with good judgment (protect the customer, protect the business)

- Answering product questions with empathy because honestly, a lot of our customers are nervous about hair loss

- Spotting recurring issues and flagging them so we can fix the root cause



You're a great fit if you

- Have 2+ years of CX experience in ecommerce or DTC

- Write clear, warm, professional English (we'll test this in the application)

- Make smart refund and return decisions (we need empathy AND business sense)

- Are proactive. You flag problems and suggest solutions, you don't just execute

- Genuinely care about your replies, because our customers are emotionally invested in seeing results



Bonus points if you have

- Experience with Shopify and Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, or Re:amaze

- Background in supplements, beauty, wellness, or women's health

- Experience handling subscriptions (cancellations, skips, swaps)

- Familiarity with 3PL coordination or order tracking troubleshooting



Compensation and hours

- Salary: $750/month base, plus performance bonuses when you hit all KPIs (we'll walk you through exactly what those look like)

- Hours: Full time, 40 hours a week

- Growth path:  We track performance with a real KPI and leaderboard system. If you're putting in the work, you'll get recognized for it (and rewarded for it).



How to apply

Please send us three things:



1. Your updated CV

2. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

3. A short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes max) covering:



A quick intro about yourself

- Your CX experience and the brands or platforms you've worked with

- Why you think you'd be a great fit for Bloom & Bond



The Loom is important to us because we want to get a real feel for how you communicate, not just how you write. No need to script it or make it fancy, just be yourself.



Applications missing any of the three items won't be reviewed. We're hiring people who follow instructions and care about details, because that's exactly what our customers need from us.



Looking forward to meeting you
